description: This file defines enums, structs, and functions related to probing and authenticating remote gateways within the OpenClaw application on macOS. It handles various authentication issues, results of gateway probing, and includes network connection checks.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeResult
classes.description: An enum representing the result of a remote gateway probe, which can be ready, report an authentication issue, or failure with a message.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeSuccess
classes.description: A struct conveying successful connection info, including authentication source and associated descriptive properties.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.run
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check to determine the status and accessibility of the remote gateway, including validation of connection parameters and SSL/WebSocket URLs.

calls: ShellExecutor.run(command: sshCommand, cwd: nil, env: nil, timeout: 8)
